name: Your Name
summary: Three to five sentences. Lead with what the posting asks for first, not with your favourite project. Put a number in it. State availability at the end.

items.meta: City | Mon YEAR to Mon YEAR | scale, e.g. platform serving N customers
bullets: Project Name: what you built, what it does, and the number that makes it real. The bold label must name an actual project. check_spread.py rejects topic labels like Reliability work, because that is how a fourth bullet about the same system sneaks on disguised as a new one.
Another Project: a second distinct project. At least three across the section, at most two bullets from any single one.
A Third Project: keep bullets around forty to fifty words. Nobody reaches the good number at the end of a ninety word bullet.

items.meta: City | Mon YEAR to Mon YEAR
bullets: Plain bullets without a bold label are fine outside the lead role.
Include a non-work project only when it carries something the job history does not.

sections.title: Technical Skills
items: the ones you would defend in an interview
use plain parseable headers: Databases, Cloud, Testing. Clever headers do not parse.
